# Crimson Warrior — Free Top-Down Pixel Art Character Pack

- Source: <https://igormoroniy.itch.io/crimson-warrior-free-top-down-pixel-art-character-pack>
- Author: Igormoroniy
- License: free for commercial use; credit is appreciated but not required.
- Downloaded: 2026-08-11

The original `crimson-warrior-free-pack.rar`, extracted source files, preview GIFs, and
the editable `all animations.aseprite` document are preserved under `source/`.
Runtime-ready directional PNG strips are copied to `assets/sprites/player_crimson/`.
The asset is used as the playable Crimson Warrior in Ashen Covenant.
